gt_provenance.details: Data source is real Swiss-Prot sequences (external GT). The interpretability gate uses an LLM-consistency self-supervised proxy (no external interpretability GT exists for SAE features). Dual-type evaluation by design; proxy is documented.

score_normalization.details: No self-normalization. Counts and ratios are raw integers and ratios.

result_existence.details: All cited numbers match result files: est_sae=1480 matches runs/m1/layer9.json (1480.05), ratio=19.3x matches 19.27. All 6 layer files exist.

dead_code.details: Pipeline executed end-to-end; 6 result files present, all status=done in tracker, gate_features_sample populated.

scope.details: 1500/10k sequences (~15%), auto-interp estimated from 100-feature sample. UniRef windows unavailable. Claim uses qualified 'up to ~2,548'. All subsample sizes transparently disclosed. Ratio criterion MET; absolute count short by ~40%.
